name: storehand
description: An extra pair of hands for your store. A Claude Code plugin with open-source skills that turn Claude into your daily Shopify operator. Today: store setup, a daily briefing (orders, payment problems, cancellations, stock alerts) and a weekly health check (sold-out products, broken links, discount and metadata gaps). On the way: listing writing, price watching, SEO audits and weekly reports. Read-only by default, no telemetry.

scripts.check: npm run scan && npm test && npm run validate
